column1: # ext_encoding_diff::matrix_dump (EXT_ENC_MATRIX): libexpat 2.9.0 (C) vs expat-rs (Rust), recorded separately.
# Whole-document feeding, XML_PARAM_ENTITY_PARSING_ALWAYS, ExtHandler::Read, no namespaces.
# Columns: context (G general entity, S external subset, P parameter entity, V parameter entity in an entity value)
#   parent protocol encoding/scheme, body, encodingName, Rust result, C result, equal|DIFF
# Result: <status> <code> @<line>:<column>/<byte index> child[<ok> <code> <line> <column> <byte index>; ...] ret[<handler return values>]
# CONFIG rows (body u8, encodingName NULL): context, standalone, handler mode, param entity parsing,
#   not-standalone handler, call counts in the C trace, Rust result, C result, equal|DIFF.
# Only the parent NULL/Utf8 rows are kept; all four parent encodings are regenerated by
#   EXT_ENC_MATRIX=<file> cargo test -p expat-difftest --test ext_encoding_diff matrix_dump
